label_policy: A past ticket is 'useful' when a careful support agent would say it describes the same problem (the same symptom in the same product area), so its recorded resolution is a sensible first thing to check. Sharing a topic or vocabulary, a different symptom, or a different product is not enough. Labels are judgements made by reading the tickets; they are not ground truth from the customer.
separation: Queries are built only around historical tickets with an odd id number, plus the four supplied examples.
